description: Return the Pearson correlation of each currency's daily returns with `base` over a window (−1..1), plus the number of overlapping observations. Use for diversification or co-movement questions such as "does CHF track EUR?". `currencies` is required and comma-separated; a non-USD `base` is usually more meaningful. Use `analyze_volatility` for dispersion and `analyze_history` for raw change. Defaults: 365-day window ending today. Returns `{ base, from, to, results[] }`; `correlation` is null when it is undefined for the window. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

base.description: Reference currency to correlate against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD (a non-USD base is more meaningful).

currencies.description: Comma-separated currencies to correlate with `base`, e.g. GBP,CHF,SEK.

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to 365 days before `to`.

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

name: analyze_correlation
title: Correlation analysis
